Method of Attack: The code of the eazyminer package was duplicated and used in over 1200 other packages, designed to utilize unused resources of machines such as ci/cd and web servers. However, the copied code includes a miner functionality intended to be triggered from within another program and not as a standalone tool, hence it won't run upon installation. The attacker made changes in the miner’s configuration files, including the URL to which the mined cryptocurrency should be sent.
Attack Vector: The attacker is using automation to launch malicious packages at a scale where almost every package being published has a unique NPM account, created using custom-built automation processes. The attacker is also using disposable email addresses with REST API to defeat NPM 2FA challenge when creating a user account.
